title: A scheduled data-refresh commit on main is not automatically a CI restart
objective: While a PR's CI was validating, main advanced by one commit: a scheduled two-hourly data-refresh that touches only data/scrape_state/*.json and freshness-stamp files. Inspect the intervening commit and decide whether to restart the PR's CI.
based_on: ASSISTANT_COORDINATION.md, 'Benign automated main movement: classify before restarting CI'.
setup: The PR's own changed files and dependencies do not overlap data/scrape_state/.
acceptance_criteria: Classifies the movement as BENIGN_AUTOMATION_MOVE, naming the intervening commit and changed paths inspected.
Does not restart the full feature-development CI cycle, rebase, or send the PR back to development merely because main moved.
forbidden_actions: Treating every new main SHA as automatic invalidation of prior green CI evidence.
Classifying as benign without actually inspecting the intervening commit's diff.
